title: UNAFFI
headline: Find opportunities to play. Manage the business behind them.
summary: A sports platform connecting people with facilities and activities, while giving businesses the tools to manage listings, schedules, bookings, memberships, and payments. People can discover and book sporting opportunities, or organise free community activities for others to join.

highlights.title: Discover & play
highlights.description: Find facilities, book and pay, or join community activities.

highlights.title: Manage your business
highlights.description: Manage listings, schedules, bookings, memberships, and payments.

supportingText: Anyone can organise free community activities. Memberships can include service benefits such as free court bookings.

title: FIMO Polymer Clay Colour Recipe Generator
headline: From colour inspiration to a precise mixing recipe.
summary: Turns the FIMO True Colours mixing guide into a personalised recipe card. Choose a target colour and total clay weight to get precise mixing quantities—removing manual calculations and guesswork, and helping creators reduce waste.

title: Budgit
headline: A clearer picture of household spending and savings.
summary: A personal finance app built around how I manage household money. It categorises income and expenses, tracks monthly budgets, and compares projected savings with actual savings after unexpected costs.

highlights.title: Multiple households
highlights.description: Manage households with multiple contributing members.

highlights.title: Flexible budget cycles
highlights.description: Set the start day and warning/danger thresholds for each household.

highlights.title: Backup & restore
highlights.description: Local and Google Drive backup and restore of household data.

supportingText: Built for my own household finances, and open source for anyone who wants to adapt it to theirs.
